</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* network printk() should be guarded by net_ratelimit() function -- see
 * net/core/utils.c */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_PRINTK(args...)                                                   \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">  do {                                                                         \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">    if (net_ratelimit())                                                       \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">      printk(args);                                                            \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">  } while (0)</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define MODERATE_LIMIT 32</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define MAXMODERATE_ARGS 16</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* this macro avoids filling kernel log with the same message hundred of times.
 * There are MAXMODERATE_ARGS different messages that can be registered by means
 * of the enumeration moderate_print_sections below. The associated message is
 * printed by printk only every MODERATE_LIMIT times.
 * The variable used by this macro must be globally declared in the file/module
 * that uses it and its name must be `moderate_print. It must be an unsigned int
 * array of dimension MAXMODERATE_ARGS. An example is represented in
 * ipfi_machine, where `moderate_print is declared at the beginning of the file
 * and initialized to 0 values in the initialization method `init_translation()'
 * via the memset function.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_MODERATE_PRINTK(id, args...)                                      \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">  do {                                                                         \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">    if (id &lt; MAXMODERATE_ARGS) {                                               \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">      if (moderate_print[id] % moderate_print_limit[id] == 0) {                \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">        moderate_print[id]++;                                                  \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">        IPFI_PRINTK(args);                                                     \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">        IPFI_PRINTK(&quot;[message repeated %u times. Next repetition in %u &quot;       \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">                    &quot;events of the same type]\n&quot;,                              \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">                    moderate_print[id], moderate_print_limit[id]);             \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">      } else {                                                                 \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">        moderate_print[id]++;                                                  \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">      }                                                                        \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">    }                                                                          \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">  } while (0)</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">moderate_print_sections</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">PRINT_PROTO_UNSUPPORTED</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">PRINT_SKB_ALLOC_FAILED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">PRINT_TEST</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* register here other custom sections */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">END_MODERATE_LIST</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">MAXMODERATE_ARGS</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">checksum_errors</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">BAD_IP_CSUM</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">BAD_TCPHEAD_CSUM</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">BAD_TCPHEAD_CHECK</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">BAD_UDPHEAD_CHECK</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cm">/* loguser:
                 if loguser &gt;= 2  implicit denial is sent back;
                 if loguser &gt;= 4 implicit and explicit denial;
                 if loguser &gt;= 5 all filtering is sent back;
                 if loguser &gt;= 6 filtering and pre/post stuff is sent.
                 commands in do_control are always sent back: loguser
                 then decides to print or not information. To have information
                 printed on commands received _at_startup_ loguser
                 must be 7.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* loglevel
    if loglevel &gt; 3 printk of rule added in manage_rule()
    (ipfi_netl.c );
    if loglevel &gt; 2 printk of command received in do_control
    (ipfi_netl.c);
  */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">masquerade</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">all_stateful</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">free</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">user_allowed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">noflush_on_exit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="nl v-local">loglevel</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* logging level by means of printk */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="nl v-local">loguser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* sending information to userspace */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">snatted_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dnatted_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">state_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">setup_shutd_state_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">max_loginfo_entries</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cm">/* if *cnt reaches ULONG MAX, it must be reset to 0 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">check_packet_num</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">cnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nf_hook_state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">_flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_pre_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_post_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">recalculate_ip_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* updates sent counter, sends packet to userspace and calls
 * update_kernel_stats()
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* prints just tcp checksum, for debug. To remove */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">print_check</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Callback to free a rule removed from the linked list. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">free_rule_rcu_call</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">rcu_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">head</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">log_skb_tuple</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* TCP */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdrlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">tcp_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">pr_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">TCP %pI4:%u -&gt; %pI4:%u</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* UDP */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdrlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">udp_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">pr_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">UDP %pI4:%u -&gt; %pI4:%u</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Other protocols */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">pr_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IP proto=%u %pI4 -&gt; %pI4</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## ipfire.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* ip firewall Giacomo S. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;build.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;filter/defrag.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;filter/state/state_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;globals.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;helpers/icmp_nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;mangle/tcpmss.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;module_init.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;netlink/ipfi_netl.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;netlink/message_builder.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;proc/proc.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/init.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/list.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/netfilter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/net_namespace.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/tcp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/udp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_POST_ROUTING NF_INET_POST_ROUTING</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_LOCAL_IN NF_INET_LOCAL_IN</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_LOCAL_OUT NF_INET_LOCAL_OUT</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_FORWARD NF_INET_FORWARD</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_LICENSE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">GPL</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_AUTHOR</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Giacomo S. &lt;delleceste@gmail.com&gt;</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_DESCRIPTION</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE-wall: A high-performance, stateful IPv4 packet filter.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Features:</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Stateful Inspection: Advanced TCP/UDP/ICMP state tracking.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - NAT: SNAT, DNAT, and Masquerading support.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Lifecycle Management: Unified ipfi_entry with RCU and per-entry </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">timers.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Slab Allocation: Dedicated kmem_cache for state, NAT, and log </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">entries.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Smart Logging: Rate-limited, duplicate-suppressed logging system.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Protocol Helpers: Optimized support for Passive FTP.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Networking: TCP MSS clamping and IPv4 defragmentation.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Userspace: Netlink-based control, ruleset sync, and statistics.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Network Namespaces (netns):</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - per_net=0 (default): Hooks registered in init_net only.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - per_net=1: Hooks in all namespaces; tables (state, NAT, logs) are </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">shared.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Primary use: Local host firewalling and cross-netns performance </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">testing.</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">drop</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">module_param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">policy</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">charp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IRUSR</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IWUSR</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IRGRP</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IWGRP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_PARM_DESC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">default_policy</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s">accept</span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s"> or </span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s">drop</span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s"> policy as default.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * per_net — Network namespace hook registration mode.
 *
 * 0 (default): Hooks are registered in init_net only. The firewall sees
 *              traffic on the host's main network stack. Packets inside
 *              other namespaces (even through loopback) are invisible
 *              because each namespace has its own netfilter hook chain.
 *
 * 1:           Hooks are registered in every network namespace via
 *              register_pernet_subsys(). All namespaces share the same
 *              state, NAT, and log tables (no per-namespace isolation).
 *
 * The per_net=1 mode is primarily intended for local performance testing:
 * flood traffic between namespaces on the same host to measure firewall
 * overhead without flooding the physical network.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">per_net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">module_param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">per_net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IRUGO</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_PARM_DESC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">per_net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Hook registration mode: 0=init_net only (default), 1=all namespaces.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">With per_net=0, traffic in non-init namespaces is not filtered.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">welcome</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* packet counters */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">in_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">out_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">fwd_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">pre_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">post_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">time64_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">module_load_time</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* bad checksum counter for packets received */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">badcsum_cnt_rcv</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">iph_in_get_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* invoke engine function passing the appropriate rule lists */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_INPUT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfire_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">in_drop</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">in_acc</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_OUTPUT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfire_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">out_drop</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">out_acc</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FWD</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfire_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwd_drop</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwd_acc</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: iph_in_get_response(): invalid direction!</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">response</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-global">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">register_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">unregister_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfire_net_init</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">register_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">pernet_operations</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">ipfire_net_ops</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">init</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_net_init</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">exit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_net_exit</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
