</span><span class="cm">/*
 * Hook Registration
 *
 * nf_register_net_hook() is namespace-scoped: hooks only fire for packets
 * traversing the struct net they were registered in.
 *
 * per_net=0: register_ipfire_net(&amp;init_net) — only the host's own traffic.
 *            Other namespaces have their own hook chains and are unaffected.
 *
 * per_net=1: register_pernet_subsys() — hooks fire in every namespace.
 *            Useful for local performance testing: create namespaces with
 *            veth pairs and flood packets between them to measure firewall
 *            overhead, without sending any traffic on the physical network.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifdef _BUILD_VERSION</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define KERNEL_MODULE_VERSION _BUILD_VERSION</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">else</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define KERNEL_MODULE_VERSION &quot;2.0.0-alpha&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifdef _BUILD_CODENAME</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define KERNEL_MODULE_CODENAME _BUILD_CODENAME</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">else</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define KERNEL_MODULE_CODENAME &quot;lin&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define BUILD_DATE _BUILD_DATE</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define BUILD_SYS _BUILD_SYS</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">welcome</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timespec64</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tv_load_time</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: MODULE INITIALIZED [%s] codename %s built on %s, %s - </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Giacomo S. </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">&lt;delleceste@gmail.com&gt;</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="n v-local">KERNEL_MODULE_VERSION</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">KERNEL_MODULE_CODENAME</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">BUILD_DATE</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="n v-local">BUILD_SYS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* set loading time into kernel stats struct */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ktime_get_real_ts64</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">tv_load_time</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">module_load_time</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tv_load_time</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">tv_sec</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Allocate per-CPU counters */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">alloc_percpu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_counters</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to allocate per-CPU counters</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n v-local">ENOMEM</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Set default policy and write it in kernel stats */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_options</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">set_policy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">policy</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">kstats</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">kstats</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">default_policy</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">kstats</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">kmod_load_time</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">module_load_time</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">init_procentry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">PROCENT</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">policy</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">set_procentry_values</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">userspace_control_pid</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">userspace_data_pid</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Initialize ruleset lists before any potential notifier event */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_ruleset_heads</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Allocate global workqueue for entry cleanup (before component init) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">alloc_workqueue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">ipfire_wq</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">WQ_MEM_RECLAIM</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to allocate workqueue</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n v-local">ENOMEM</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">init_netl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* registers netdevice notifier */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">per_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">register_pernet_subsys</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_net_ops</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to register pernet subsystem</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">register_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">init_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__init</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ini</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">welcome</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__exit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * ===== SHUTDOWN SEQUENCE =====
   *
   * The unified lifecycle (ipfi_entry) uses a deferred-free chain:
   *
   *   flush_all / timer_cb
   *     → ipfi_entry_put()
   *       → queue_work(ipfire_wq, cleanup_work)      [step A: work queued]
   *         → free_entry_work()
   *           → timer_delete_sync()
   *           → call_rcu(free_entry_rcu)              [step B: RCU cb queued]
   *             → free_entry_rcu()
   *               → kfree(h)                          [step C: actual free]
   *
   * To safely destroy kmem_cache, we must ensure step C has completed
   * for ALL entries. This requires:
   *
   *   1. we_are_exiting = true        → stop new allocations
   *   2. synchronize_net()            → finish in-flight packet hooks
   *   3. unregister hooks             → no more packets
   *   4. fini_machine / fini_log /    → flush_all queues work items (step A)
   *      fini_translation
   *   5. destroy_workqueue(ipfire_wq) → flushes &amp; runs all work items,
   *                                      which post call_rcu (step B)
   *   6. rcu_barrier()                → waits for all call_rcu callbacks
   *                                      to finish (step C — kfree done)
   *   7. kmem_cache_destroy(...)      → now safe, all objects freed
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 1: signal exit --- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">WRITE_ONCE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">we_are_exiting</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">true</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 2: unregister hooks ---
   * Stop new packets from entering the module's paths */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">per_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">unregister_pernet_subsys</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_net_ops</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">unregister_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">init_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 3: wait for in-flight RCU readers (packet hooks) ---
   * synchronize_net() calls synchronize_rcu() internally.
   * Note: synchronize_rcu() only waits for _readers_, NOT for
   * call_rcu() _callbacks_ — that's what rcu_barrier() is for.
   * We do this AFTER unregistering hooks so we know no new
   * packets are entering. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">synchronize_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 4: flush all tables ---
   * Each fini function calls ipfi_table_flush_hash() (or flush_all for LRU
   * lists), which:
   *   - iterates buckets/lists, marks entries REMOVED
   *   - calls ipfi_entry_put() → queues cleanup work on ipfire_wq */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* fini_netl(): just calls sock_release on the netlink socket */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_netl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">clean_proc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 5: flush the workqueue ---
   * destroy_workqueue() drains all pending work items.
   * This runs free_entry_work() for every entry, which calls
   * timer_delete_sync() + call_rcu(free_entry_rcu).
   * After this, all call_rcu callbacks are _posted_ but may
   * not have _executed_ yet. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">destroy_workqueue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 6: wait for all RCU callbacks ---
   * rcu_barrier() blocks until every call_rcu(free_entry_rcu)
   * posted in step 5 has finished executing (i.e., kfree done).
   * After this returns, no slab objects are in use. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_barrier</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 7: destroy slab caches ---
   * All objects have been freed, safe to tear down the caches. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">state_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nat_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">free_percpu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">set_policy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">def_policy</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">strncmp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">def_policy</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">accept</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">kstats</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">default_policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">kstats</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">default_policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_options</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">opts</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">opts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* by default, users are allowed to insert their rules.
   * Administrator, to avoid users' rules, have to start
   * firewall with option noflush and disabling users */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">opts</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">user_allowed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="c1">// enum nf_ip_hook_priorities {
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_FIRST = INT_MIN,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK_DEFRAG = -400,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_RAW = -300,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_SELINUX_FIRST = -225,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK = -200,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_MANGLE = -150,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_NAT_DST = -100,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_FILTER = 0,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_SECURITY = 50,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_NAT_SRC = 100,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_SELINUX_LAST = 225,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK_CONFIRM = INT_MAX,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_LAST = INT_MAX,
</span><span class="c1">// };
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * register_ipfire_net - Initialize and register netfilter hooks for a namespace
 *
 * This function sets up the hook structures (nf_hook_ops) that define our
 * packet processing callbacks, then registers them in the given namespace.
 *
 * Returns: 0 on success, negative error code on failure
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">register_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Setup hook structures (using global ops for simplicity if they can be
   * shared)
   * Note: In modern kernels, nf_hook_ops can be shared if they are immutable.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* PRE_ROUTING: Defragmentation hook (highest priority) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_defrag</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK_DEFRAG</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* pre routing */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_NAT_DST</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* input */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_LOCAL_IN</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_FILTER</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* forward */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_FORWARD</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_FILTER</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* output */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_LOCAL_OUT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_FILTER</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* output - defrag */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_defrag</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_INET_LOCAL_OUT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK_DEFRAG</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* post routing */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_post</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_post</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_POST_ROUTING</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_post</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_NAT_SRC</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_post</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Register hooks for the given net namespace */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err_pre</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err_in</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err_fwd</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err_out</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err_defrag_out</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_post</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err_post</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Error handling - unregister in reverse order */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">err_post</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">err_defrag_out</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">err_out</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">err_fwd</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">err_in</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">err_pre</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">err_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">unregister_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_post</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_net_hook</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_info_t_nlmsg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sent_tou</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_send_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">LISTENER_DATA</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">printk</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters skb_send failed</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FAILED_NETLINK_USPACE</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">resp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to allocate memory for socket buffer in </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters()</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_pre_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* in pre routing we do not do any filtering. In normal cases we will return
   * IPFI_ACCEPT as verdict in this hook. In case of errors instead, we'll
   * return IPFI_DROP, to interrupt packet processing. This happens in case of
   * checksum error in incoming packets or (unprobable) memory allocation
   * errors
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* MASQUERADE or NAT are enabled: go on! */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more kmalloc for ipfire_info_t. We use stack-based flags and response.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more build_ipfire_info_from_skb or init_packet needed for translation
   * here. Translation functions now take skb and components directly.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* if it's an ICMP error for a NATed connection, handle it directly */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_ICMP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">icmp_nat_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* The outer Dst IP changed (e.g. local .245 -&gt; remote .25).
       * The cached routing decision (LOCAL_IN) is now stale.
       * Drop it so the kernel re-evaluates routing → FORWARD.
       */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* if a packet comes back from a dnatted connection,
   * i.e. has been forwarded, we must de dnat it. Dynamic
   * rules are checked in this case.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_dnatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">pre_de_dnat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* implements pre processing of the packets: DNAT.
     * check if we already have a translation for this session
     * (early lookup consolidated here)
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">lookup_nat_forward</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">dest_translate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* dnat_translation() requires direct match with DNAT rules inserted by user.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* no pre_de_dnat, maybe dnat_translation */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">dnat_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* now let's de-snat, or de-masquerade, if no match has previously succeeded
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_snatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">pre_de_snat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* checksum is calculated inside set_pairs_in_skb(), ipfi_translation.c */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">nat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* we send to userspace old packet, to let see how translation changed it,
     * if loguser is greater than 5 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">userspace_data_pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">is_to_send</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* not sent because of log level */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">not_sent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">BAD_CHECKSUM</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">we_are_exiting</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">not_sent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">bad_checksum_in</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: bad checksum on incoming packet %llu over %llu received.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">bad_checksum_in</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">pre_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* send a packet signaling an error */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more kfree(packet) needed */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_post_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* do post routing tasks. Checksumming is performed in set_pairs_in_skb(),
   * the manipulation function inside ipfi_translation.c
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">de_dnat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* stats — use per-CPU counters to avoid cache-line bouncing */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">post_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more kmalloc for ipfire_info_t. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* MASQUERADE and SNAT now take components directly. No
   * build_ipfire_info_from_skb needed here. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* if it's an ICMP error for a NATed connection, handle it directly */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_ICMP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">icmp_nat_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_POST_ROUTING</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Translation applied, accept packet immediately */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">post_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_dnatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/*
     * Consolidate: both post_snat_dynamic() and de_dnat_translation()
     * do lookup_nat_idx(NAT_DNAT, NAT_IDX_POSTNAT, skb), which probes
     * the exact same hash bucket. Do ONE lookup and handle both cases:
     *   - dynamic masquerade (forward packet through DNAT entry)
     *   - de-DNAT (reply packet returning from DNAT target)
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">lookup_nat_idx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Try dynamic masquerade first (forward direction) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_dynamic_table_match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">state_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
