</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_dynamic_translate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Update/Add Reply index with the new Masquerade address */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">reply_key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_nat_tuple_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_addr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_port</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                             </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                             </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_add_index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">reply_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Try de-DNAT (reverse direction) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">de_dnat_table_match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">state_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">de_dnat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">de_dnat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* check if we already have a translation for this session
   * (early lookup consolidated here, covers both SNAT and Masquerade)
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_snatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">lookup_nat_forward</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_SNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* masquerade_translation() scans masquerade_post list */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">masquerade_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* snat_translation scans translation_post list */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">de_dnat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">nat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1U</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">snat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1U</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">userspace_data_pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">is_to_send</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* not sent because of log level */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">not_sent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Don't check for bad checksum on outgoing packets.
   * See netfilter ip_conntrack_proto_tcp.c comment */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* checksumming... */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nf_hook_state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* 0.98.4: When we have to DNAT in output direction, we have to
   * check if the original destination is allowed by the
   * filter rules. Imagine we have setup a proxy web and the
   * user wants to block connections to www.badsite.com.
   * If the output connections are redirected to the proxy
   * by means of an OUTPUT DNAT rule, the connection will
   * pass through also if it is not desired.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">iph_in_get_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* decide according to loguser if to send or not feedback */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">userspace_data_pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">is_to_send</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_info_t_nlmsg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* shouldn't happen :r */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to allocate memory for socket buffer in </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">iph_in_get_response()</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_send_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">LISTENER_DATA</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FAILED_NETLINK_USPACE</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Qt-GUI: if gui_notifier_enabled we send the info if there is no match
     * (popup asking the user the verdict for the new seen packet - if
     * directions are in or out -) OR if there was a rule matching and a
     * notification was requested for tha packets matching _that_ rule.
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">gui_notifier_enabled</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_IMPLICIT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FWD</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">         </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_IMPLICIT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">notify</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">printk</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">GUI NOTIFIER ENABLED!!</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* previous socket buffer sent to userspace: the kernel will have freed
       * it... so the pointer skb_touser is no more valid: create a new socket
       * buffer with the same ipfire_info_t contents: this will be sent via
       * the notifier socket.
       */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_info_t_nlmsg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_send_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">GUI_NOTIF_DATA</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">failed to send message to userspace via netlink: %d</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                    </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FAILED_NETLINK_USPACE</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* packets not sent because of log level */</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">not_sent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* update the sum of the packets processed */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sum</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* update statistics */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Map internal IPFI verdicts to netfilter verdicts:
   * IPFI_ACCEPT (2) -&gt; NF_ACCEPT (1)
   * IPFI_DROP (1) -&gt; NF_DROP (0)
   * IPFI_IMPLICIT (0) -&gt; apply default_policy
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_DROP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* IPFI_IMPLICIT: apply default policy */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">default_policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* no more needed since 1.96 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">recalculate_ip_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph_sum_old</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">network_header_null</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">recalculate_ip_checksum()</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">socket buffer NULL</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph_sum_old</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_fast_csum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* tcp */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">switch</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">tcp_v4_check</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">udp_v4_check</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">default</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* see include/skbuff.h: &quot;B.Checksumming on output&quot;:
   * CHECKSUM_NONE: skb is checksummed by protocol or csum is not required.
   * If checksum is calculated here, no need to recalculate it. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_OUTPUT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_OUTPUT_POST</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ip_summed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">CHECKSUM_NONE</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">module_init</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ini</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">module_exit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">fini</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## ipfi_macros.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* macros in ip_input.c, ip_output.c, ip_forward.c */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_INPUT_FUNCTION()  \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">ipfi_packet_input_counter ++; \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_input_processing != NULL) </span><span class="cm">/* pre routing processing */</span><span class="cp"> \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{ \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	printk(&quot;INPUT: LOCAL_DELIVER()  [LOCAL_IN]: %lu\n&quot;, ipfi_packet_input_counter); 	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if( ipfi_input_processing(skb, ipfi_packet_input_counter, IPFI_INPUT) == IPFI_DROP)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		return IPFI_DROP;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	else	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_packet_input_counter % PRINTK_WARN_IPFI_DISABLED == 0)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		printk(&quot;IPFI: WARNING: FIREWALL DISABLED [input packet n. %lu]\n&quot;,	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		       ipfi_packet_input_counter);	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_PRE_FUNCTION() \</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">ipfi_packet_pre_counter ++;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">if(ipfi_pre_processing != NULL) </span><span class="cm">/* pre routing processing */</span><span class="cp">	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	printk(&quot;INPUT: IP_RCV [LOCAL_PRE]: %lu\n&quot;, ipfi_packet_pre_counter);	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if( ipfi_pre_processing(skb, ipfi_packet_pre_counter, IPFI_INPUT_PRE) == IPFI_DROP)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		return IPFI_DROP;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	else	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_packet_pre_counter % PRINTK_WARN_IPFI_DISABLED == 0)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		printk(&quot;IPFI: WARNING: FIREWALL DISABLED [input pre packet n. %lu]\n&quot;,	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		       ipfi_packet_pre_counter);	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}	</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_OUTPUT_FUNCTION()	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">ipfi_packet_output_counter ++;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">if(ipfi_output_processing != NULL) </span><span class="cm">/* pre routing processing */</span><span class="cp">	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_output_processing(skb, ipfi_packet_output_counter, IPFI_OUTPUT) 	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		  == IPFI_DROP)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		return IPFI_DROP;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	else	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_packet_output_counter % PRINTK_WARN_IPFI_DISABLED == 0)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		printk(&quot;IPFI: WARNING: FIREWALL DISABLED [output packet n. %lu]\n&quot;,	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		       ipfi_packet_output_counter);	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_POST_FUNCTION()	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">ipfi_post_packet_counter++;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	printk(&quot;IPFI_FINISH_OUTPUT() [POSTROUTING]: %lu\n&quot;, ipfi_post_packet_counter);	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_post_processing == NULL)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_post_packet_counter % PRINTK_WARN_IPFI_DISABLED == 0)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		printk(&quot;IPFI: WARNING FIREWALL DISABLED [output post packet n.%lu]\n&quot;,	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		       ipfi_post_packet_counter);	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	else	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_post_processing(skb, ipfi_post_packet_counter, IPFI_OUTPUT_POST) == IPFI_DROP)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		return IPFI_DROP;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_FWD_FUNCTION() 	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">ipfi_packet_forward_counter ++;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">if(ipfi_forward_processing != NULL) </span><span class="cm">/* pre routing processing */</span><span class="cp">	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if( ipfi_forward_processing(skb, ipfi_packet_forward_counter, IPFI_FWD) == IPFI_DROP)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		return IPFI_DROP;	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">else	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">{	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">	if(ipfi_packet_forward_counter % PRINTK_WARN_IPFI_DISABLED == 0)	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		printk(&quot;IPFI: WARNING: FIREWALL DISABLED [forward packet n. %lu]\n&quot;,	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">		       ipfi_packet_forward_counter);	\</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">}</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## ipfi_entry.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* ipfi_entry.h — Common lifecycle header for all ipfire table entries
 *
 * Every table entry struct (state_table, nat_table) embeds an
 * ipfi_entry_head as its FIRST member. The lifecycle functions in
 * table_lifecycle.c operate on this embedded header.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_ENTRY_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_ENTRY_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/hashtable.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/jhash.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/list.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/percpu_counter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/rcupdate.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/refcount.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/spinlock.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/timer.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/workqueue.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Bit index for the &quot;entry has been removed from its list&quot; flag */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED 0</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">workqueue_struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * struct ipfi_entry_head - common header embedded in every table entry
 *
 * This must be the FIRST member of any table entry struct, so that
 * container_of(head, struct whatever, h) works uniformly and the
 * pointer to the head IS the pointer to the entry.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timer_list</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">timer</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">work_struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">cleanup_work</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">rcu_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">rcuh</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">list_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">lnode</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* list linkage (used by loginfo LRU) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_node</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">hnode</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* hash linkage */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">refcount_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">refcnt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">status</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">last_timer_update</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ===== Lifecycle functions (table_lifecycle.c) ===== */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_entry_init - Initialise lifecycle fields of a new entry.
 * @h:         pointer to the embedded head
 * @timeout_s: initial timeout in seconds
 *
 * Sets up the timer, work struct, refcount (at 0 — caller must set it),
 * status (cleared), and initial expiry.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_init</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">timeout_s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">timeout_fn</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timer_list</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_entry_arm_timer - Start the timer after entry has been added to its
 * list.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_arm_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">mod_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">expires</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_entry_hold / ipfi_entry_put - refcount management.
 *
 * When refcount drops to zero, _put queues the cleanup work which
 * syncs the timer and then schedules RCU-delayed kfree.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_hold</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">refcount_inc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">refcnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_entry_hold_rcu - Try to acquire a reference in RCU context.
 * Returns true if successful, false if the entry is already dead (0 refcnt).
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">refcount_inc_not_zero</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">refcnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_entry_update_timer - Throttled timer refresh.
 * @h:        entry head
 * @proto:    protocol (IPPROTO_*)
 * @state:    current connection state (int, passed to get_timeout_by_state)
 *
 * Skips if REMOVED is set or if last update was &lt;5 s ago.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_entry_remove - Unlink an entry from its container (under caller's lock).
 * @h:       entry head
 * @counter: pointer to the entry counter (decremented)
 *
 * List build: does list_del_rcu + set_bit(REMOVED) + counter-- + put.
 * Hash build: does hlist_del_rcu + set_bit(REMOVED) + counter-- + put.
 * The caller MUST hold the protecting spinlock.
 *
 * The thread that wins the test_and_set_bit(REMOVED) race calls
 * ipfi_entry_put(h) internally. The loser is a complete no-op.
 * Callers must NOT call ipfi_entry_put() after this function.
 *
 * ipfi_entry_put() calls queue_work(), which is safe from BH-disabled
 * spinlock context (queue_work takes an internal irqsave lock, never sleeps).
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_table_flush_all - Remove and put all lnode-linked entries.
 *

 * Process-context only (sleepable).
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_table_flush_all</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">list_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">list</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                         </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_table_flush_hash - Remove and put all hnode-linked entries.
 *
 * Used by the state table and log table.
 * Process-context only (sleepable).
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_table_flush_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ht</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">nbuckets</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                          </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_table_flush_hash_bucketed - Remove and put all hnode-linked entries
 * using per-bucket spinlocks.
 *
 * Process-context only (sleepable).
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_table_flush_hash_bucketed</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ht</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">nbuckets</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">locks</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* IPFI_ENTRY_H */</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## table_lifecycle.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* table_lifecycle.c — Unified lifecycle management for ipfire table entries
 *
 * Provides refcounting, timer management, RCU-safe destruction, and
 * bulk flush for any struct that embeds an ipfi_entry_head as its
 * first member (state_table, nat_table, ipfire_loginfo).
 *

 *   - List build  (default off): uses list_head / lnode for O(N) traversal
 *   - Hash build  (default on):  uses hlist_node / hnode for O(1) lookups
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * OWNERSHIP AND DELETION CHAIN
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Every entry starts with refcount = 1 (the &quot;container reference&quot;).
 * The lifecycle is:
 *
 *   CREATED (refcnt=1)
 *       │
 *       ▼
 *   LINKED into list/hash + timer armed
 *       │
 *       ▼  timer fires  ──or──  eviction (loginfo only)
 *   ipfi_entry_remove()          [under table spinlock]
 *     ├─ test_and_set_bit(REMOVED)   ← atomic &quot;winner&quot; gate
 *     ├─ hlist_del_rcu / list_del_rcu
 *     ├─ counter--
 *     └─ ipfi_entry_put()            ← winner puts, loser is no-op
 *           └─ refcount → 0
 *                 └─ queue_work(ipfire_wq, cleanup_work)
 *                       └─ [workqueue / process context]
 *                             timer_delete_sync()
 *                             call_rcu(free_entry_rcu)
 *                                   └─ [RCU callback]
 *                                         kfree(h)
 *
 * KEY INVARIANTS
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * 1. REMOVED bit is set exactly once (test_and_set_bit).
 * 2. ipfi_entry_put is called exactly once (by the winner of the bit race).
 * 3. kfree happens only after: timer is dead AND RCU grace period has
 *    elapsed, guaranteeing no CPU is still touching the object.
 * 4. queue_work() is safe from BH-disabled spinlock context because it
 *    uses spin_lock_irqsave internally and never sleeps.
 *
 * LOGINFO SPECIAL CASE (see log.c)
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * loginfo entries maintain TWO simultaneous links in hash mode:
 *   lnode → active_logi_list   (LRU eviction, O(1) tail access)
 *   hnode → loginfo_hashtable  (deduplication lookup, O(1))
 *
 * ipfi_entry_remove only handles hnode. The lnode is managed explicitly
 * by the loginfo timer callback and eviction path, both under
 * loginfo_list_lock, guarded by a REMOVED pre-check to prevent
 * double list_del_rcu (which would write to LIST_POISON addresses).
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_entry.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/bitops.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/jiffies.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/list.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/percpu_counter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/rculist.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/slab.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/spinlock.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Forward declaration: timeout helper from state_timeout.c */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_timeout_by_state</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- RCU callback: final kfree ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">free_entry_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">rcu_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">rcu</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">container_of</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">rcu</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">rcuh</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * All entries are allocated via kmem_cache_alloc.
   * kfree() handles kmem_cache objects correctly on
   * modern kernels (6.x) via virt_to_slab().
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kfree</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Work handler: process-context cleanup ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">free_entry_work</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">work_struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">work</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">container_of</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">work</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">cleanup_work</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Safe in process context */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">timer_delete_sync</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* After RCU grace period, kfree the entry */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">call_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">rcuh</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">free_entry_rcu</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Public API ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_init</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">timeout_s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">timeout_fn</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timer_list</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">INIT_WORK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">cleanup_work</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">free_entry_work</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">timer_setup</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">timeout_fn</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">expires</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">jiffies</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">HZ</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">timeout_s</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">last_timer_update</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">jiffies</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* refcnt is NOT set here — caller is responsible
   * (refcount_set before or after init as appropriate). */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
