</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">refcount_dec_and_test</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">refcnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * Defer final cleanup via workqueue so we don't risk kfree'ing
   * while other contexts (RCU readers, timers) may touch the object.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">WARN_ON</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">queue_work</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">system_wq</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">cleanup_work</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">queue_work</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">cleanup_work</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">unlikely</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">time_after</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">jiffies</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">READ_ONCE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">last_timer_update</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">HZ</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">timeout</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Safely get a reference while under RCU/pointer validity */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Re-check removal bit under the reference */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">unlikely</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">timeout</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_timeout_by_state</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">mod_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">jiffies</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">HZ</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">timeout</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">WRITE_ONCE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">last_timer_update</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">jiffies</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_entry_remove - Unlink an entry from its container (under caller's lock).
 *
 * CRITICAL: test_and_set_bit(REMOVED) MUST happen BEFORE the del_rcu call.
 * Only the thread that successfully sets the bit unlinks the entry.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_entry_remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_and_set_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* loser: complete no-op */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Entries are tracked by hnode in hash mode */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_add_batch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * Winner always puts. queue_work() is safe from BH-disabled spinlock
   * context: it uses spin_lock_irqsave internally and never sleeps.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ============================================================
 * List-mode bulk flush (always compiled — used by NAT tables
 * regardless of whether hash mode is active for the state table)
 * ============================================================ */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_table_flush_all</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">list_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">list</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                         </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">list_for_each_entry_safe</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">list</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">lnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_and_set_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">list_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">lnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ============================================================
 * Hash-mode bulk flush
 * ============================================================ */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * ipfi_table_flush_hash - drain all entries from a hash table.
 * @ht:       the hlist_head array (e.g. state_hashtable)
 * @nbuckets: number of buckets (ARRAY_SIZE of the hash table)
 * @lock:     the spinlock protecting the table
 * @counter:  pointer to the entry counter (zeroed)
 *
 * Mirrors ipfi_table_flush_all() for the hash case.
 * Process-context only (sleepable, calls queue_work via ipfi_entry_put).
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_table_flush_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ht</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">nbuckets</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                          </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_node</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">nbuckets</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_for_each_entry_safe</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">ht</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_and_set_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/*
         * ipfi_entry_put only calls queue_work(), which is
         * safe from BH/spinlock context.
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_table_flush_hash_bucketed</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ht</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">nbuckets</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">locks</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_node</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">nbuckets</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_for_each_entry_safe</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">ht</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_and_set_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Since we don't have a global lock during flush, we just sum up what's left
   * and reset. This is typically used during unload where traffic flow is
   * stopped anyway. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">counter</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_FILTER_ENGINE_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_FILTER_ENGINE_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;common/ipfi_structures.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="c1"> /* for ipfire_options if needed, or forward declare */</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* struct ipfire_options is defined in ipfi.h usually or ipfi_structures? 
   It's in ipfi.h based on typical usage. Let's check ipfi.h content if needed.
   For now assuming it's available via ipfi.h inclusion.
*/</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">ipfire_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">denied</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">allowed</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_opts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_tmp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ftp</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">next_drop_rule</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">device_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">rule</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">in</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">next_drop_rule</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">drop</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_layer_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">rule</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">in</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ip_layer_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net_device</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">in</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net_device</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_tcp_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">tcph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">udp_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">udph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">icmp_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">icmph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## filter/rule_match.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* filter/rule_match.c: Rule matching logic for ipfire-wall */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/ip.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/tcp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/udp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/icmp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/netdevice.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">direction_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">nflags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">device_filter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net_device</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">in</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net_device</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* don't bother if user fills in output rule within input context
        * or viceversa */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">nflags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">indev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">in</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">strncmp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">in</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">name</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">devpar</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">in_devname</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IFNAMSIZ</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">nflags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">outdev</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">out</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">strncmp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">out</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">name</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">devpar</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">out_devname</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IFNAMSIZ</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">address_match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net_device</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">in</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net_device</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">match</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">addr_in_list</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">source_address</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">p_source_address</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dest_address</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">p_dest_address</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* source address */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Set correct source and destination address: the one corresponding
    * to the interface in packet if MYADDR was specified, the dotted
    * decimal one if ADDR is specified in flags */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">nflags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">src_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">MYADDR</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_dev_ifaddr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">p_source_address</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">in</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">out</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">source_address</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">p_source_address</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">source_address</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ip</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ipsrc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* initialize addr_in list */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">addr_in_list</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* a single ip is given: it must match exactly */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">nflags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">src_addr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">r</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">parmean</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">samean</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">SINGLE</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">source_address</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">match</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* an interval is given: src address in packet must be contained in it.
    * Addresses cannot be mine */</span><span class="w">

## filter/header_check.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_HEADER_CHECK_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_HEADER_CHECK_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Prints an error message and always returns -1.
 * It is used to signal on syslog a network IP or TCP or UDP 
 * header null and to return the -1 as error code.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">network_header_null</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">funcname</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">message</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/kernel.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">network_header_null</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">funcname</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">message</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">	</span><span class="n v-func-call">printk</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: %s: %s</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">funcname</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">message</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">	</span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## filter/defrag.h

</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_DEFRAG_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_defrag</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">priv</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">

## filter/defrag.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/types.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/ip.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/netfilter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/route.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/ip.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="c1">/// toglier
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/tcp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;filter/defrag.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Returns new sk_buff, or NULL */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_gather_frags</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">u_int32_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">user</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_orphan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">local_bh_disable</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Process an incoming IP datagram fragment. - net/ipv4/ip_fragment.c */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_defrag</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">init_net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">user</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">local_bh_enable</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_send_check</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* Generate a checksum for an outgoing IP datagram. (net/ipv4/ip_output.c) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_defrag</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">priv</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                      </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nf_hook_state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Gather fragments. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Fragment Offset: 13-bits  used to identify where each of the fragments belong at the time of reassembly.
     * IP_MF = 0x2000, IP_OFFSET = 0x1FFF -&gt; ored make 13 bits.
	 * NF_STOLEN means don't continue to process the packet and not deallocate it.
	 * NF_DROP, equivalent to IPFI_ACCEPT, means don't continue to process the packet, but deallocate it. 
	 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">frag_off</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">htons</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IP_MF</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IP_OFFSET</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">		 </span><span class="cm">/* include/net/ip.h defines IP_DEFRAG_CONNTRACK_IN and IP_DEFRAG_CONNTRACK_OUT: might suit */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_gather_frags</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">		  </span><span class="n v-local">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IP_DEFRAG_CONNTRACK_IN</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IP_DEFRAG_CONNTRACK_OUT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">		</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_STOLEN</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">		</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## nat/nat.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_NAT_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_NAT_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;common/ipfi_structures.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/refcount.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/slab.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/timer.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/workqueue.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define SO_IPFI_GETORIG_DST 200 </span><span class="cm">/* a number */</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define SNAT_ENTRY 0</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define DNAT_ENTRY 1</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define DNAT_HASH_BITS 10</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define SNAT_HASH_BITS 10</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">typedef</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* 0 is not valid */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">valid</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">net_quadruplet</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_NAT_REMOVED 0</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">pkt_manip_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">sa</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">sp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">da</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="nl v-local">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* 4 bits as in ipfire_rule */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">workqueue_struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Common functions */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">net_quadruplet</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_quad_from_skb</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* given source and destination addresses and ports, this function sets them
 * in socket buffer passed as parameter. In case of TCP or UDP protocols,
 * returns 1, 0 for ICMP, -1 in case of errors
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">manip_skb</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">pkt_manip_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">pf</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* checks ip and transport checksums, returning 0  if correct,
 * a negative value picked from enum checksum_errors (ipfi.h) otherwise */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">check_checksums</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* prints the checksum error message according to the checksum_errore enum
 * defined in ipfi.h and returns -1. Introducted in 0.99.2
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">csum_error_message</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">origin</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">enum_code</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* skb contains the fields taken from sk_buff, r is the translation rule.
 * In this function, the skb must match the rule provided by user for
 * DNAT or SNAT (or MASQUERADE). 1 is returned on success
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">translation_rule_match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">r</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* returns 1 if network address is a private one conforming
 * to rfc 1918, 0 otherwise */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">private_address</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">addr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* returns 1 if packet comes from a public host and
 * gets redirected to an internal host. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">public_to_private_address</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">transrule</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* copies address in *address, looking for devices with name

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif </span><span class="cm">/* IPFI_NAT_H */</span><span class="cp">
