</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_tcpudp_magic</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                          </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ip_summed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">CHECKSUM_COMPLETE</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">csum</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n v-local">BAD_TCPHEAD_CSUM</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_tcpudp_magic</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                          </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ip_summed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">CHECKSUM_COMPLETE</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">csum</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n v-local">BAD_UDPHEAD_CSUM</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nf_sockopt_ops</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">so_getoriginal_dst</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">get_optmin</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">SO_IPFI_GETORIG_DST</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">get_optmax</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">SO_IPFI_GETORIG_DST</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">get</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">get_original_dest</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_register_sockopt</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">so_getoriginal_dst</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">might_sleep</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">nf_unregister_sockopt</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">so_getoriginal_dst</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## nat/nat_table.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* nat/nat_table.h — Unified NAT table structure
 *
 * Replaces the separate snatted_table and dnatted_table structs.
 * Every NAT entry (SNAT or DNAT) is represented as a struct nat_table
 * with a type flag.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_NAT_TABLE_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_NAT_TABLE_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../ipfi_entry.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;common/ipfi_structures.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/netdevice.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/percpu_counter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_SNAT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_index</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_ORIG</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* MUST be first. h-&gt;hnode is ORIG index. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_node</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h_indices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* POSTNAT and REPLY */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Original packet fields */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_dport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Translated fields:
   *   SNAT: new_addr = new source addr, new_port = new source port
   *   DNAT: new_addr = new dest addr,   new_port = new dest port
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_addr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_port</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">our_ifaddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* DNAT dynamic SNAT reverse, 0 for SNAT */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">external</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nolog</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">protocol</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">state</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">type</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">uint32_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">rule_id</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">position</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">keys</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkts</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">active_indices</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* bitmask of enum nat_index */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">in_ifindex</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">out_ifindex</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">in_devname</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">IFNAMSIZ</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">out_devname</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">IFNAMSIZ</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">rulename</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">RULENAMELEN</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* DNAT only, empty for SNAT */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Inline hold/put delegating to lifecycle ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">nat_hold</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_hold</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">nat_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- NAT table functions (nat_table.c) ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Hash functions */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_snat_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">old_daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">old_dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_dnat_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">old_saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">old_sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_nat_tuple_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Lookup:
 * All lookup functions search RCU-protected hash tables.
 *
 * lookup_nat_idx:
 *   - Internally handles rcu_read_lock_bh().
 *   - Returns entry with a reference hold (nat_hold_rcu).
 *   - Caller MUST call nat_put() when finished.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">lookup_nat_idx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_index</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">idx</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                 </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* lookup_nat_forward:
 *   - Internally handles rcu_read_lock_bh().
 *   - Wraps lookup_nat_idx(NAT_IDX_ORIG).
 *   - Updates timer and state internally.
 *   - Returns entry with a reference hold.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">lookup_nat_forward</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fill_nat_entry_fields</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                          </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                          </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                          </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">rule</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Supplemental index management */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">nat_add_index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">nt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_index</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">idx</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Compare */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">compare_nat_entries</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">a</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">b</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Timer callback */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">handle_nat_entry_timeout</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timer_list</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">t</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Flush */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">free_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Init/Fini */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Access to per-type globals — implemented as arrays indexed by nat_type.
 * In hash mode, entries are stored in nat_hashtables and nat_counters.
 * In list mode, entries are stored in nat_lists and nat_counters.
 * Locks and counters are always present.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NAT_HASH_BITS 8</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_counters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kmem_cache</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">nat_cache</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif </span><span class="cm">/* IPFI_NAT_TABLE_H */</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## nat/nat_table.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* nat/nat_table.c — Unified NAT table management for ipfire-wall
 *
 * Merges the former snat_table.c and dnat_table.c into a single
 * implementation. All SNAT and DNAT entries share the same struct
 * nat_table and lifecycle functions from table_lifecycle.c.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;nat_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../filter/state/state_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../globals.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/bitops.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/gfp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/hashtable.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/jhash.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/slab.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/timer.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Per-type globals ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Hash tables: two arrays of hlist_head, one per nat_type */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* (defined in common/globals.c via globals.h extern) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* (defined in common/globals.c via globals.h extern) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_counters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kmem_cache</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">nat_cache</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">d</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">s</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">free_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_SNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">d</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">free_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_counters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_SNAT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_counters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: NAT tables freed: snat=%d dnat=%d</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">d</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* kmem_cache_destroy deferred to ipfire.c::fini() after
   * destroy_workqueue + rcu_barrier ensure all kfree callbacks ran. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nat_cache</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">ipfi_nat</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                </span><span class="n v-local">SLAB_HWCACHE_ALIGN</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">nat_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to create NAT slab cache</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n v-local">ENOMEM</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_read_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Forward match (for original direction) ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Lookup: by entry comparison (for duplicate detection) ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Lookup: by forward 5-tuple (for existing session reuse) ----
 *
 * Wraps lookup_nat_idx for the original direction.
 * Internally handles RCU protection and state/timer updates.
 *
 * Returns entry with reference hold.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">lookup_nat_forward</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">lookup_nat_idx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_ORIG</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">state_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Flush ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">free_nat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_node</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Supplemental indices must be cleared first.
   * We don't call ipfi_entry_put here because the final ORIG flush
   * will handle entry destruction.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* 1. Flush POSTNAT index */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_for_each_entry_safe</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="n v-local">h_indices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Only the thread that marks the entry as REMOVED (either the
       * final ORIG flush or a timer) should handle supplemental unlinking.
       * However, during module unload we clear everything. We check the
       * status to avoid double-deletion if a timer is firing. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h_indices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">active_indices</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">~</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* 2. Flush REPLY index */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_for_each_entry_safe</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                              </span><span class="n v-local">h_indices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h_indices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">active_indices</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">~</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* 3. Flush ORIG index (standard traversal of h.hnode) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_table_flush_hash_bucketed</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_ORIG</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_ORIG</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_counters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## nat/translation.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* DEPRECATED: usage of this file is deprecated.
 * Please include nat/nat.h, nat/snat/snat.h or nat/dnat/dnat.h instead.
 * This file will be removed in future.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_TRANSLATION_DEPRECATED_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_TRANSLATION_DEPRECATED_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="c1">//#warning &quot;ipfi_translation.h is deprecated. Use nat/nat.h instead.&quot;
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## mangle/mangle.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_MANGLE_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_MANGLE_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * mangle_skb() - Apply packet manipulations based on firewall rule settings
 * @pm: packet manipulation structure from the firewall rule
 * @skb: socket buffer to modify
 * @flow: flow information (direction, interfaces)
 * @reverse: flag indicating if this is a reverse-direction packet
 *
 * Returns: &lt;0 on error, 0 if no manipulation needed/applied, &gt;0 if manipulation succeeded
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">mangle_skb</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">packet_manip</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/** @return != 0 if some field is set inside packet_manip *pm, 0 otherwise 
 *  @param pm pointer to struct packet_manip to evaluate.
 *
 *  The function simply memcmps pm with a zero filled struct packet_manip, to see if
 *  some field of the structure pm has been set. 
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">some_manip_enabled</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">packet_manip</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## mangle/mangle.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;mangle/mangle.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;mangle/tcpmss.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * mangle_skb() - Apply packet manipulations based on firewall rule settings
 * @pm: packet manipulation structure from the firewall rule
 * @skb: socket buffer to modify
 * @flow: flow information (direction, interfaces)
 * @reverse: flag indicating if this is a reverse-direction packet
 *
 * This function examines the packet_manip structure from a firewall rule
 * and applies any enabled manipulations. Currently supports:
 * - TCP MSS clamping (for PMTU discovery)
 *
 * Returns: &lt;0 on error, 0 if no manipulation needed/applied, &gt;0 if manipulation succeeded
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">mangle_skb</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">packet_manip</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* TCP Maximum Segment Size manipulation 
   * Only applied if:
   * 1. MSS mangling is enabled in the rule (pm-&gt;mss.enabled)
   * 2. Packet is suitable (TCP SYN or SYN/ACK)
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">mss</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">enabled</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">packet_suitable_for_mss_change</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">tcpmss_mangle_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">mss</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">option</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">mss</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">mss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">some_manip_enabled</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">packet_manip</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">packet_manip</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">zero_manip</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">zero_manip</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">zero_manip</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* memcmp returns 0 if the two memory areas match */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">memcmp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">pm</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">zero_manip</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">packet_manip</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## mangle/tcpmss.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_TCPMSS_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_TCPMSS_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/types.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">u_int32_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_net_mtu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">address</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">tcpmss_mangle_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">option</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">mss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">packet_suitable_for_mss_change</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">optlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">u_int8_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">opt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">offset</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## mangle/tcpmss.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;mangle/tcpmss.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/tcp.h&gt;</span><span class="c1"> /* TCPOLEN_MSS... */</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/version.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* private manip function */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">__tcpmss_mangle_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">option</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">mss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* TCPOLEN_MSS: length of the tcp header mss option, from include/net/tcp.h 
 * TCPOPT_MSS: segment size negotiating, from include/net/tcp.h
 * TCPOPT_NOP: padding, from include/net/tcp.h
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * packet_suitable_for_mss_change() - Determine if packet is suitable for TCP MSS manipulation
 * @skb: socket buffer containing the packet
 * @flow: flow information (direction, interfaces)
 * @reverse: flag indicating if this is a reverse-direction packet (reply)
 *
 * TCP MSS (Maximum Segment Size) mangling is needed for Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD).
 * When packets traverse networks with different MTUs (e.g., PPPoE with 1492 vs Ethernet 1500),
 * the firewall may need to clamp MSS to prevent fragmentation issues.
 *
 * MSS mangling is ONLY applicable to TCP SYN packets because:
 * - MSS option is negotiated during connection establishment (SYN, SYN/ACK)
 * - Once negotiated, it cannot be changed mid-connection
 * - Mangling non-SYN packets would break the connection
 *
 * Returns: 1 if packet is suitable for MSS manipulation, 0 otherwise
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">packet_suitable_for_mss_change</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Extract IP header from socket buffer */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* MSS mangling only applies to TCP protocol */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Extract TCP header (located iph-&gt;ihl * 4 bytes after IP header) */</span><span class="w">
