</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* CASE 1: Outgoing SYN packet (connection initiation)
     * - SYN=1, ACK=0 indicates initial SYN packet from client
     * - This is where initial MSS is advertised
     * - We may need to clamp it to prevent PMTU issues
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">syn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ack</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* CASE 2: Forwarded SYN/ACK packet in reverse direction (server reply)
     * - Direction is FORWARD (packet being routed)
     * - SYN=1, ACK=1 indicates SYN/ACK reply from server  
     * - reverse=1 means this is the return packet of an established flow
     * - Server's MSS also needs clamping to match path MTU
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FWD</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">syn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ack</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Diagnostic: SYN/ACK in forward but not reverse - shouldn't happen normally
     * This indicates a potential state tracking issue
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FWD</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">syn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ack</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: SYN+ACK packet not marked as reverse - unexpected!</span><span class="se">\\</span><span class="s">n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* All other packets (data, ACK, FIN, etc.) are not suitable for MSS mangling */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">optlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">u_int8_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">opt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">offset</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Beware zero-length options: make finite progress */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">offset</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOPT_NOP</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">offset</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-param">offset</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* code taken from xt_TCPMSS.c, net/netfilter */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">u_int32_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_net_mtu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">address</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* generic internet flow structure */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">rtable</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">rt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">u_int32_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">mtu</span><span class="w">     </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">~</span><span class="mi">0U</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* ipv4 only */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">flowi4</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">fl4</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">address</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">rt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_route_output_key</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">init_net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fl4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">IS_ERR</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">rt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">mtu</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">dst_mtu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">rt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dst</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_rt_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">rt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">mtu</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * tcpmss_mangle_packet() - Mangle TCP MSS option in a packet
 * @skb: socket buffer containing the packet to modify
 * @tcpmss_option: type of MSS manipulation (MSS_VALUE or ADJUST_MSS_TO_PMTU)
 * @mss: target MSS value (only used if tcpmss_option == MSS_VALUE)
 *
 * This is the main entry point for TCP MSS manipulation. It:
 * 1. Calls __tcpmss_mangle_packet() to modify the MSS option in TCP header
 * 2. If successful, updates the IP header total_length and checksum
 *
 * The function may enlarge the packet if the MSS option needs to be added.
 * In this case, ret &gt; 0 indicates how many bytes were added.
 *
 * Returns: &lt;0 on error, 0 if no change needed, &gt;0 if packet was enlarged
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">tcpmss_mangle_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">tcpmss_option</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">mss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newlen</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Perform the actual MSS mangling */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">__tcpmss_mangle_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">tcpmss_option</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">mss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* If packet was enlarged (MSS option was added), update IP header */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Socket buffer has been enlarged by 'ret' bytes
         * Calculate new total length: old_length + bytes_added
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">newlen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">htons</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">tot_len</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Update IP header checksum to reflect new total length 
         * csum_replace2(): efficiently updates checksum by replacing old value with new
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">tot_len</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newlen</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">tot_len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newlen</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">__tcpmss_mangle_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">tcpmss_option</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">mss</span><span class="cm">/*,
                           ipfire_info_t *info*/</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcplen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcphoff</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">mtu_minlen</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">oldval</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">u_int16_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">oldmss</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">net_mtu</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">mtu_minlen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_ensure_writable</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFI: __tcpmss_mangle_packet(): skb_ensure_writable failed</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* reload pointers after skb_make_writable() call */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">tcphoff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">tcplen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcphoff</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_network_header</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcphoff</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* (1) Since it passed flags test in tcp match, we know it is is
     * not a fragment, and has data &gt;= tcp header length.  SYN
     * packets should not contain data: if they did, then we risk
     * running over MTU, sending Frag Needed and breaking things
     * badly. --RR
     *
         * (1) Quoted from net/netfilter/xt_TCPMSS.c
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcplen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">doff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: __tcpmss_mangle_packet(): bad tcp header length (%u bytes)</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">tcpmss_option</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ADJUST_MSS_TO_PMTU</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">dst_entry</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">dst_en</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_dst</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">net_mtu</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_net_mtu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">dst_mtu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dst_en</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">mtu_minlen</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">__tcpmss_mangle_packet(): unknown or invalid skb PATH-MTU (%u)</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">dst_mtu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dst_en</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">net_mtu</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">mtu_minlen</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">__tcpmss_mangle_packet(): unknown or invalid calculated PATH-MTU (%u)</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">net_mtu</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">dst_mtu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dst_en</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">net_mtu</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">mtu_minlen</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">mss</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* first byte of the tcp header */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">u_int8_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* cycle: start: i: first byte after the end of the tcp header;
     *        test:  i: less than tcp header data offset (start of data) - the number of 32 bit words in the TCP Header
     *   increment:  i: length of option
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">doff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">optlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* TCPOLEN_MSS: length of the tcp header mss option, from include/net/tcp.h
           * TCPOPT_MSS: option `segment size negotiating', from include/net/tcp.h
           * Maximum Segment Size

            +--------+--------+---------+--------+
            |00000010|00000100|   max seg size   |
            +--------+--------+---------+--------+
            Kind      Length:4
           *
           * note: tcph-&gt;doff * 4 - i must be greater than or equal TCPOLEN_MSS (4 bytes: 1:kind,2:length,3,4:mss)
           */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOPT_MSS</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">doff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">oldmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="c1">// 			IPFI_PRINTK(&quot;oldmss: %u   ----------------  new mss (possibile): %u [i = %d]\n&quot;, oldmss, newmss, i);
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="cm">/* Never increase MSS, even when setting it, as
             * doing so results in problems for hosts that rely
             * on MSS being set correctly.
             */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="c1">// info-&gt;manipinfo.pmanip.mss.enabled = 1;
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">oldmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="c1">// info-&gt;manipinfo.pmanip.mss.old_lessthan = 1;
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="c1">// info-&gt;manipinfo.pmanip.mss.mss = oldmss;
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="cm">/* else: fill in the new mss */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mh">0xff00</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mh">0x00ff</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="c1">// info-&gt;manipinfo.pmanip.mss.mss = newmss;
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="cm">/* update checksum */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="n v-func-call">htons</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">oldmss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">htons</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: mss option not found. Adding</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/*
     * MSS Option not found ?! add it..
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_tailroom</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_expand_head</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_tailroom</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">GFP_ATOMIC</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_network_header</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcphoff</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* net/core/skbuff.c: skb_put - add data to a buffer.
     * Extends the used data area of the buffer of an amount TCPOLEN_MSS
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">u_int8_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* (tcplen = skb-&gt;len - tcphoff) move memory pointed by opt (tcph + sizeof(struct tcphdr) = start of data
     * into opt + TCPOLEN+MSS
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">memmove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tcplen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">htons</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcplen</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">htons</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcplen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOPT_MSS</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mh">0xff00</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newmss</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mh">0x00ff</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">opt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">oldval</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* old value calculation to use in csum_replace.. below */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">doff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">   </span><span class="cm">/* new start of data position */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">oldval</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// info-&gt;manipinfo.pmanip.mss.skb_enlarged = 1;
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">TCPOLEN_MSS</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">EXPORT_SYMBOL</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">packet_suitable_for_mss_change</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">EXPORT_SYMBOL</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">tcpmss_mangle_packet</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## logging/log.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_LOG_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_LOG_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_entry.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/list.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/spinlock.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/types.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* MUST be first */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">info</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kmem_cache</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">build_ipfire_info_from_skb</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">dest</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">packet_matches_log_entry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p2</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">compare_loginfo_packets</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">packet2</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">packet_not_seen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">chk_state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">smart_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">smart_log_with_state_check</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">add_packet_to_infolist</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                  </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## logging/log.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* ipfi_log.c: a packet to be logged is really sent to userspace only if
 * it is not identical to a one previously sent. This reduces kernel/user
 * communication load */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/***************************************************************************
 *  Copyright  2005  Giacomo
 *  jacum@libero.it
 ****************************************************************************/</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;logging/log.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;globals.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/gfp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/hashtable.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/jhash.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/percpu_counter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/slab.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * DESIGN:
 *
 * Log entries follow the unified ipfi_entry lifecycle (table_lifecycle.c):
 *
 * 1. ALLOCATION: kmem_cache_alloc from a dedicated slab cache.
 * 2. LIFECYCLE:  Each entry has an individual timer that fires on
 *                expiration. On duplicate match, the timer is refreshed
 *                via ipfi_entry_update_timer() using IPPROTO_IPFI_LOG
 *                as sentinel protocol (throttled to 5s).
 * 3. REMOVAL:    Timer callback calls ipfi_entry_remove + ipfi_entry_put.
 *                ipfi_entry_put defers to workqueue -&gt; timer_delete_sync
 *                -&gt; call_rcu -&gt; kfree (handles kmem_cache objects on 6.x).
 * 4. MAX CAP:    loginfo_entry_counter is checked before allocation.
 *                If at capacity, the oldest entry is evicted.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Dedicated slab cache for ipfire_loginfo entries ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kmem_cache</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * get_log_hash - compute the hash bucket key for a log-deduplication entry.
 * @saddr:  IPv4 source address (network byte order)
 * @daddr:  IPv4 destination address (network byte order)
 * @proto:  IP protocol number (IPPROTO_TCP, IPPROTO_UDP, IPPROTO_ICMP, …)
 *
 * DESIGN: 3-TUPLE KEY vs. 5-TUPLE (state/NAT tables)
 * ---------------------------------------------------
 * State and NAT tables use the full 5-tuple (saddr, daddr, sport, dport,
 * proto) as their hash key.  This is correct for those tables because each
 * lookup must retrieve *one specific connection*: sport and dport together
 * make every flow unique, so the extra discrimination cuts collision chains
 * to near-zero even at high connection rates.
 *
 * The log-deduplication table has a different contract.  packet_not_seen()
 * never returns a single authoritative entry; it scans every entry in the
 * bucket and delegates the actual equality test to compare_loginfo_packets(),
 * which performs a full content comparison (IPs, ports, flags, direction,
 * rule ID, connection state).  The hash key here is only a *pre-filter*: its
 * job is to route the lookup to the right bucket quickly, not to identify the
 * entry by itself.
 *
 * Using a 3-tuple (saddr, daddr, proto) trades a slightly longer per-bucket
 * scan in exchange for two concrete advantages:
 *
 *   1. PROTOCOL GENERALITY.  ICMP, IGMP, GRE, PIM and other protocols carry
 *      no port numbers.  A 5-tuple key would require special-casing (zero-
 *      filling sport/dport) for each of these, and would still place all
 *      portless packets from the same host pair in the same bucket — so the
 *      extra complexity buys nothing.  The 3-tuple handles all protocols
 *      uniformly with a single code path.
 *
 *   2. LOG SEMANTIC.  A log entry represents &quot;a class of recently-seen
 *      packets between this src/dst pair using this protocol&quot;.  Two TCP
 *      connections from the same client to the same server on different
 *      ephemeral ports are still the same logging event from a firewall
 *      visibility standpoint.  Grouping them in the same bucket is
 *      semantically appropriate; the full comparison in
 *      compare_loginfo_packets() still distinguishes them when needed.
 *
 * Note: with LOG_HASH_BITS=7 (128 buckets) and a typical loginfo table
 * that stays well below max_loginfo_entries, per-bucket chains are short
 * regardless.  A migration to a 5-tuple key (to mirror state/NAT) is a
 * valid future optimisation for very large deployments.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_log_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">jhash_3words</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">__u32</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">__u32</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Timer callback ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">handle_loginfo_timeout</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timer_list</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">t</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">timer_container_of</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">t</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_list_lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * BUG FIX: check REMOVED *before* list_del_rcu.
   *
   * loginfo_evict_oldest() runs under the same lock and does:
   *   list_del_rcu(lnode) → ipfi_entry_remove (sets REMOVED, puts internally)
   *
   * If eviction already ran, lnode.prev/next are LIST_POISON. Calling
   * list_del_rcu again writes to LIST_POISON address → memory corruption
   * → silent hard panic. Guard with the REMOVED bit which is set atomically
   * by ipfi_entry_remove under this same lock.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">list_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">lnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_entry_counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* puts internally if winner */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_list_lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Allocation ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_alloc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_alloc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">GFP_ATOMIC</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_init</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_lifetime</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">handle_loginfo_timeout</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">refcount_set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">refcnt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Eviction (when at capacity) ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="c1">// must be called under spinlock_bh
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_evict_oldest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">oldest</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Caller MUST hold loginfo_list_lock */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">list_empty</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">active_logi_list</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* lnode removal: ipfi_entry_remove removes hnode in hash mode, so we
   * remove lnode first to keep active_logi_list consistent before remove. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">oldest</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">list_last_entry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">active_logi_list</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">lnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
