</span><span class="cm">/*
 * rehash_ftp_expectation — one-shot optimisation for FTP passive data flows.
 *
 * When a passive-mode FTP 227 response is parsed, we create an expectation
 * entry with sport=0 (wildcard) because the client's ephemeral data port is
 * unknown at that point.  This entry is hashed into the sport=0 bucket.
 *
 * On the first data-connection packet, lookup_ftp_expectation() finds the
 * entry via the sport=0 bucket (secondary lookup).  The caller may then
 * invoke this function to:
 *   1. Fill in the real client source port (new_sport).
 *   2. Move the entry from the sport=0 bucket to the correct 5-tuple bucket.
 *   3. Set ftp = FTP_ESTABLISHED so subsequent packets hit the normal O(1)
 *      hash path and bypass the secondary lookup entirely.
 *
 * This is purely an optimisation — without it, every data packet would go
 * through the secondary lookup, which is still correct but O(bucket_size)
 * per packet.  For FTP traffic volumes, either approach is acceptable.
 *
 * Lock ordering: when two distinct buckets must be locked, the lower-numbered
 * bucket is always locked first to prevent AB-BA deadlocks.
 *
 * NOT WIRED UP YET — call site needs to be added once the caller decides
 * to use this optimisation.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">rehash_ftp_expectation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_state_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                 </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* MUST use hash_min() — same function as
   * hash_add_rcu/hash_for_each_possible_rcu */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_key</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">STATE_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_state_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                 </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">new_key</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">STATE_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ftp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTP_ESTABLISHED</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Lock ordering to prevent deadlocks */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ftp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTP_ESTABLISHED</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_add_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">state_hashtable</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * lookup_ftp_expectation — secondary hash lookup for FTP passive data flows.
 *
 * The FTP helper creates expectation entries with sport=0 (wildcard) because
 * the client's ephemeral source port is unknown when parsing the 227 response.
 * These entries live in the hash bucket keyed by:
 *   get_state_hash(client_ip, server_data_ip, 0, server_data_port, TCP)
 *
 * For passive FTP, the client opens the data connection to the server:
 *   src = client_ip : client_ephemeral   (sport of the outgoing SYN)
 *   dst = server_data_ip : server_data_port  (dport of the outgoing SYN)
 *
 * So we probe the hash with dport (= server data port), which matches
 * the expectation's stored dport.  The sport wildcard (0) is handled
 * inside direct_state_match() when ftp == FTP_DEFINED.
 *
 * Must be called under rcu_read_lock_bh().
 *
 * Returns the matched state_table entry, or NULL if no expectation matches.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">lookup_ftp_expectation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Probe with sport=0 (wildcard) and the server data port as dport.
   * MUST use hash_for_each_possible_rcu — it internally applies hash_min()
   * (golden-ratio multiplicative hash) to map the key to a bucket, which is
   * the same function that hash_add_rcu used when storing the entry.
   * A manual &quot;key &amp; mask&quot; bitmask computes a DIFFERENT bucket! */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_state_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_for_each_possible_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">state_hashtable</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ftp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTP_DEFINED</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_matches_state_table</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                  </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## helpers/icmp_nat.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_ICMP_NAT_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_ICMP_NAT_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../filter/state/state_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Handle internal rewriting of ICMP errors that reference heavily-NATed
 * connections. hooknum expected: NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING or NF_INET_POST_ROUTING.
 * Returns 1 on success, -1 otherwise.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">icmp_nat_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">hooknum</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Matches ICMP error payload against a state entry */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">match_icmp_error_payload</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Hashes the inner IP payload of an ICMP error for state table lookups */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_icmp_inner_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">hash_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif </span><span class="cm">/* IPFI_ICMP_NAT_H */</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## helpers/icmp_nat.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/*
 * nat/icmp_nat.c: ICMP NAT Logic
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;icmp_nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../../filter/state/state_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../nat/nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../nat/nat_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/icmp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/ip.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/tcp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/types.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/udp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/checksum.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/ip.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Helper to safely get the inner IPv4 header and the start of the inner L4
 * header */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_inner_headers</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">inner_iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Ensure we have the ICMP header */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ihl</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Check if it's an ICMP error type */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ICMP_DEST_UNREACH</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ICMP_TIME_EXCEEDED</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ICMP_PARAMETERPROB</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* The inner IP header starts after the ICMP header (8 bytes) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="n v-local">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Recompute pointers after potential pull */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">inner_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Ensure we have enough of the inner L4 header (at least 8 bytes for ports)
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Recompute pointers */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">inner_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">inner_l4h</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">inner_iph</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">inner_iph</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">recompute_icmp_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">icmp_off</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">icmph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">data</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">icmp_len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">icmp_off</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cm">/*

 * This function translates the outer IP header and the embedded inner headers

 */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">net_quadruplet</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">key</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* We only process IPv4 ICMP packets here */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_ICMP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Extract the inner network quadruplet.
   * Note: The inner packet represents the ORIGINAL traffic that caused the
   * error.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">valid</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Capture the inner protocol early to prevent TOCTOU drift */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* We only handle ICMP errors for TCP/UDP inner payloads right now */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">ipfire: icmp_nat: inner proto %u not supported</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// IPFI_PRINTK(&quot;ipfire: icmp_nat: inner quad s=%pI4:%u d=%pI4:%u prot=%u\n&quot;,
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">//             &amp;inner_quad.saddr, ntohs(inner_quad.sport), &amp;inner_quad.daddr,
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">//             ntohs(inner_quad.dport), inner_proto);
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*

   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_nat_tuple_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Try DNAT ORIG index using hash_for_each_rcu since the inner_quad hash key

   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iter_bkt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_for_each_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_ORIG</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iter_bkt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Define IP Terminology for DNAT:
         * A  = Client (Original Source)       -&gt; nt-&gt;old_saddr

         * B' = Firewall Masq/Local IP         -&gt; nt-&gt;our_ifaddr (if SNAT'd too)
         * C  = DNAT Server (Internal Target)  -&gt; nt-&gt;new_addr

         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Match Case 1: Error generated by FORWARD-direction traffic.
         * &quot;Forward&quot; means the traffic was flowing Client A -&gt; Server C.
         * Server C received A's packet, rejected it, and sent an ICMP error
         * back. The Inner Quad is that original packet sent TO Server C: Src =
         * expected_saddr (A or B') Dst = nt-&gt;new_addr (C)
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Match Case 2: Error generated by REVERSE-direction traffic.

</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Match Case 3: DNAT forward direction in POST_ROUTING.
         * The PRE_ROUTING hook already completely translated the inner packet

</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_dport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Try SNAT POSTNAT index */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="n v-local">h_indices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Define IP Terminology for SNAT:
       * A  = Client (Original Source)       -&gt; nt-&gt;old_saddr

       *

       * Server C generated the ICMP error back to B'.

</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_addr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_dport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_read_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* No translation matched */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*

   * fields are immutable once initialized.
