</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">moderate_print_limit</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">PRINT_PROTO_UNSUPPORTED</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">10000</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">kslight</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">kslight</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ctrl_so</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">data_so</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">gui_so</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini_netl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_control</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">if LINUX_VERSION_CODE &lt; KERNEL_VERSION(2, 6, 24)</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">sock_release</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_control</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">sk_socket</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">else</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">netlink_kernel_release</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_control</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_control</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">if LINUX_VERSION_CODE &lt; KERNEL_VERSION(2, 6, 24)</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">sock_release</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_data</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">sk_socket</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">else</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">netlink_kernel_release</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_data</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_data</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_gui_notifier</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">if LINUX_VERSION_CODE &lt; KERNEL_VERSION(2, 6, 24)</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">sock_release</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_gui_notifier</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">sk_socket</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">else</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">netlink_kernel_release</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_gui_notifier</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_gui_notifier</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: Closing netlink sockets (control, data, gui).</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## netlink/ipfi_netl.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_NETL_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_NETL_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* See ipfi.c for details and 
 * use of this software.
 * (C) 2005 Giacomo S.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/init.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/ip.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/notifier.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/netlink.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/time.h&gt;</span><span class="c1"> </span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/sock.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../logging/log.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../nat/snat/snat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../nat/dnat/dnat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../filter/state/state_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;common/ipfi_structures.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Smart logging */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">smartlog_type</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">SMART_LOG</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">SMART_LOG_WITH_STATE_CHECK</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* every LOG_PACKETS_RECV packets
 * received for each hook, write a line to
 * syslog */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define LOG_PACKETS_RECV 1000000ULL</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* every  LOG_NETLINK_FAILURES write
 * a message to syslog */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define LOG_NETLINK_FAILURES 25000</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* netlink related function calls */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/** @param skb socket buffer received by netlink socket callback nl_receive_control()
 * Extracts the command data structure from skb with NLMSG_DATA (extract_data() ) and
 * according to the command type, invokes one of the functions in ipfi_process_control.
 * @return less than zero if an error occurred.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">process_control_received</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nf v-global">extract_data</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_back_fw_busy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">pid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/** Handshake with userspace program: checks if structure sizes
  * are correct
  */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">initial_handshake</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">hello</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">uid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">userspace_uid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Fills in the firesizes structure with the size of the 
 * structures.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_struct_sizes</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">firesizes</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">fsz</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* copies kernel sizes in firesizes structure to send
 * back to userspace. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fill_firesizes_with_kernel_values</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">cmd</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">size_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">krulesize</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">size_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">kinfosize</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">size_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">kcmdsize</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">uid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">uspace_uid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_netl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini_netl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fill_dnat_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">dnat_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">dninfo</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">dntt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fill_snat_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">snat_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">sninfo</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">sntt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Sends in userspace the struct sizes */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_struct_sizes</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Sends in userspace the type of logging to userspace in use.
 * Reads fwopts.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_smartlog_type</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* depending on loguser, this function decides if
 * firewall has to send packet skb to userspace
 * firewall */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">is_to_send</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ipo</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* packets sent to userspace get the &quot;logu_id&quot; field incremented 
 * by one each time. If this counter exceeds ULONG_MAX, it
 * has to be re-initialized to 0, to prevent overflow */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">update_sent_counter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_data_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">pid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">destination_pid</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sock</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">which_socket</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">pid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_sender_pid</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skbff</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">set_outgoing_skb_params</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skbf</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">nl_receive_outcome</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sock</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sknl_ipfi_data_rec</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* sends an acknowledgement to userspace program 
 * before actuating a command */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_acknowledgement</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">pid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">uspace_pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* given a direction or a constant identifying the counter
 * which has to be incremented, this function increments
 * corresponding counter. Response is unsigned long
 * because if the counter to be incremented is total_lost
 * (last case), printk logs the packet_id field of packet
 * that failed to be sent. Moreover, response field is
 * copied to last_failed field of kernel stats structure. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nf v-global">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">counter_to_increment</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">response</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* checks if timeouts are too high and, if so, sets them to the
 * maximum value allowed.
 * In 32 bit architecture, maximum value for timeouts is
 * 2^32/2/HZ, see ipfi_netl.h near the definition of
 * MAX_TIMEOUT.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">check_max_timeout_values</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">cmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* sets various options related to firewall behaviour, as specified by
 * command received from userspace.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">set_firewall_options</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">cmd</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">uid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">commander</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">opts_to_cmd</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">cmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">print_command</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">cmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* adds the new rule contained inside the command to the right list of 
 * rules, depending on direction and policy */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">add_rule_to_list_by_command</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">cmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">update_ifindex_in_rules</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">name</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_index</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_ruleset_heads</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">print_loginfo_memory_usage</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">lifetime</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">print_state_entries_memory_usage</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">print_nat_entries_memory_usage</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_rule_list_to_userspace</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_a_list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">rlist</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_dnat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_snat_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_ktables_usage</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">do_userspace_exit_tasks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">uid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">userspace_commander</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">flush_ruleset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">uid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">userspace_commander</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flush_command</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">free_rules</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">uid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">user</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">free_dynamic_tables</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* NAT tables freed via free_nat_tables() in nat_table.h */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">tell_user_howmany_rules_flushed</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">howmany</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">logu_enabled</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">initial_handshake</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">hello</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">uid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">userspace_uid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">register_log_function</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">loglevel</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_back_command</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">cmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">process_data_received</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fill_state_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">stinfo</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">stt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/** @param cmd a kmallocated command.
 *  @return less than 0 in case of error (-ENOMEM)
 *
 *  The parameter cmd _must_ be a kmallocated pointer to command data structure.
 *  Never pass command* through &amp; operator in the caller!
 *  This function calls build_command_packet(cmd) obtaining a pointer to a struct sk_buff.
 *  If that pointer is not NULL, the command is ready to be sent to userspace via the
 *  netlink CONTROL socket.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">manage_rule</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">rule_from_user</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">skb_send_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">type_of_message</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_input_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_output_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_forward_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* This function is invoked when userspace firewall 
 * sends a simple exit command. It resets counters and
 * pid values for accepting new registrations for right
 * userspace firewalls */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">simple_exit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_options</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">opts</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/** @cmd the command containing the rule as content. The rule is compared with all
 * the rules in the list to establish if it is already present.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">rule_not_loaded</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">command</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">find_rules</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">rlist</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">rule</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kernel_stats</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">nl_kstats</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* sends to userspace the passed kernel_stats structure */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_kstats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Sends to userspace the passed kernel_stats light structure.
 * This is for the GUI which has a SystemTray that indicates the
 * traffic being filtered.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_kstats_light</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## proc/proc.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFIRE_PROC_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFIRE_PROC_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/proc_fs.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define PROCDIR &quot;IPFIRE&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define PROCENT &quot;policy&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define PROCENTRY_DATA_LEN 100</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* proc entry */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_procentry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">name</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">value</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">set_procentry_values</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">proc_write_ipfire</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">file</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">file</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">page</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">			     </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">count</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">data</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">			     </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">proc_read_ipfire</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">page</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">start</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">off_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">off</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">		     </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">count</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">eof</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">data</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">		     </span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">clean_proc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">set_policy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">def_policy</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## proc/proc.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;proc/proc.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/version.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/proc_fs.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/seq_file.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/uaccess.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">proc_dir_entry</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">ipfire_procent</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">procdir</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">procentry_line</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">PROCENTRY_DATA_LEN</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">state_lifetime</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">432000</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* 5 days in seconds */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">setup_shutd_state_lifetime</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">120</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_lifetime</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">30</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">max_loginfo_entries</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">256</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">smartlog_func</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-global">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Print limiting */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">moderate_print</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">MAXMODERATE_ARGS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">moderate_print_limit</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">MAXMODERATE_ARGS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="c1">// Locks. With the following macros
</span><span class="c1">// The lock is statically initialized
</span><span class="c1">// It is valid before initcall()
</span><span class="c1">// It works correctly on SMP, PREEMPT, DEBUG_SPINLOCK, etc
</span><span class="c1">// Lockdep gets the right metadata (name, class key)
</span><span class="c1">// This is the blessed way to define a global or file-scope spinlock.
</span><span class="c1">//
</span><span class="n v-global">DEFINE_SPINLOCK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">rulelist_lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">DEFINE_SPINLOCK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">loginfo_list_lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* NAT locks (Type, Index, Bucket) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">STATE_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">workqueue_struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">ipfire_wq</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-global">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">we_are_exiting</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-global">false</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Export symbols if needed by other modules, but here they are used within the

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">IPFI_OUTPUT_POST</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">post_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">IPFI_FAILED_NETLINK_USPACE</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Since total_lost is now per-CPU, a precise global check here is expensive.
         * We do a best-effort per-CPU check for logging. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">total_lost</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">%</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">25000</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">total_lost</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to send %llu packets to userspace </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">via netlink socket [loguser: %d, response: %d]!</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">total_lost</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">loguser</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                     </span><span class="n v-param">response</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">total_lost</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_write</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">last_failed</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">response</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_GLOBALS_H</span><span class="cp">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*

 * without needing a separate flat-timeout function.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPPROTO_IPFI_LOG 254</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Netlink related PIDs and sockets */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">pid_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">userspace_control_pid</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Firewall options and status */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">fwopts</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">gui_notifier_enabled</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Statistics */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kernel_stats</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">kstats</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kstats_light</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">kslight</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Per-CPU Statistics */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_counters</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__percpu</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">ipfi_counters</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_STAT_INC(field) this_cpu_inc(ipfi_counters-&gt;field)</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_get_light_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kstats_light</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">light</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">fwd_drop</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">in_acc</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">out_acc</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">fwd_acc</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">translation_pre</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">translation_post</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">translation_out</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_rule</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">masquerade_post</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* State table */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * SIZING EXPLANATION:
 * We use `1 &lt;&lt; STATE_HASH_BITS` to force the table size to be a Power of Two.
 * Example: 1 &lt;&lt; 10 = 1024.
 *
 * INTENT:
 * Computers are much faster at bitwise operations than division. By
 * guaranteeing a Power of Two size, the kernel can use a fast bitwise mask
 * (`key &amp; mask`) to find the bucket index, instead of a slow modulo operation
 * (`key % size`).
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">state_hashtable</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">STATE_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* NAT tables — per type (SNAT=0, DNAT=1); hash mode uses nat_hashtables */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NAT_HASH_BITS 8 </span><span class="cm">/* 256 buckets; override via make NAT_HASH_BITS=N */</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* NAT locks (Type, Index, Bucket) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">NAT_IDX_COUNT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Counters shared between list and hash modes */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">nat_counters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Log info — active_logi_list kept for LRU eviction even in hash mode */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">list_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">active_logi_list</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef LOG_HASH_BITS</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define LOG_HASH_BITS 7 </span><span class="cm">/* 128 buckets; override via make LOG_HASH_BITS=N */</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">hlist_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_hashtable</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">LOG_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Counters */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">table_id</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">state_tables_counter</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Inline macros to directly read for conditionals */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define get_dnatted_count() percpu_counter_read(&amp;nat_counters[NAT_DNAT])</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define get_snatted_count() percpu_counter_read(&amp;nat_counters[NAT_SNAT])</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">percpu_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_entry_counter</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">state_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">setup_shutd_state_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">max_loginfo_entries</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">smartlog_func</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                            </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                            </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">max_state_entries</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Print limiting */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">moderate_print</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">MAXMODERATE_ARGS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">moderate_print_limit</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-global">MAXMODERATE_ARGS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Locks */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">rulelist_lock</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">spinlock_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">STATE_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Other */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">extern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">bool</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">we_are_exiting</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
